s01: Every release, your engineers stop writing software, and start writing about it. Detailed designs. Interface tables. Flowcharts. Unit test specifications. By hand.
s02: What if the code could document itself, to the ASPICE standard your assessors expect?
s03: Point ArtiFex at your repository, Bitbucket or a local folder. Choose the branch, the cores, the layers. It checks everything is ready before it starts.
s04: One click. ArtiFex parses every function, global and type with a real C++ compiler front end, builds one model of the whole code base, and writes the documents from it.
s05: SWE.3 Software Detailed Design, per component. Component and unit diagrams. Header and interface tables. A flowchart for every published function. Dynamic behaviour diagrams. All the structure comes from the code. Nothing invented.
s06: And from that design, the SWE.4 Unit Test Specification, a spec for every function. Delivered as Word files your process already uses.
s07: AI writes only the wording: descriptions and labels. Your reviewers stay in control. Correct a sentence in place, and the diagram and the Word file update in seconds.
s08: Assign reviewers, request changes, approve. A version is approved when every document is, with a record of who approved what, ready for your assessment.
s09: Next release? ArtiFex compares with the last approved version, regenerates only what changed, and shows you exactly what moved.
s10: ArtiFex. Your code, documented to ASPICE, so your engineers can get back to engineering.
